business_unit.description: Business-unit presidents own line functions for their unit; shared services report to corporate executives.

enterprise.description: CEO -> business unit -> division -> VP -> director -> manager -> IC, with a full C-suite for shared services.

flat_startup.description: Shallow startup hierarchy with inflated titles, wide spans and few management layers.

functional.description: Departments grouped by function under C-level executives.

matrix.description: Functional primary reporting with dotted-line (secondary) reporting from delivery teams to product leaders.

product_based.description: General managers own product lines with embedded engineering, product and design teams; shared services stay corporate.

regional.description: Regional presidents run customer-facing functions per region; corporate functions are global.

clean.description: No injected noise. Fields a source never carries (e.g. job family in a directory) are still absent.

enterprise_complexity.description: High noise plus heavy leadership ambiguity, staleness and departures typical of large reorganizing enterprises.

high_noise.description: Heavy corruption, many missing fields and frequent cross-source disagreement.

low_noise.description: Mostly consistent records with occasional variants and gaps.

medium_noise.description: Typical multi-source mess - abbreviations, gaps, stale profiles and conflicts.

staff.title: Chief of Staff
variants: Chief of Staff to the CEO
